points.description: States dust particles as ice nuclei, specifically naming clay minerals (clay minerals as the dust type).
points.partial_credit: Half only if 'dust' is named without clay minerals, or clay minerals named without 'dust'.

points.description: States organic particles (organic matter) and ordinary ocean salts (sea salt) as ice nuclei.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of organic matter or ocean/sea salts is stated precisely.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all the listed materials: dust (clay minerals), organic particles and ocean salts. Give part marks only where one item of a point is stated precisely. A wrong extra material (e.g. smoke, pollen from an unrelated list, water vapour) or a vague answer such as 'particles in the air' earns nothing for the affected point.
